name: 混沌奥特曼
title: 混沌实体
text:
混沌头部复制高斯的身体、战斗能力和战术后形成的实体，可释放单体混沌头部五十倍的能量。它曾与高斯交战，受到日蚀之刃及克兹缪姆光线攻击后消失，随后进化再现，变化为混沌奥特曼灾厄。

身高：47米。体重：42,000吨。
version_scope: 只对应蓝银色混沌奥特曼基础体；灾厄作为变化关系单独记载，不共用本图或数值。
unit_note: 按官方原字段保存；不从照片外框推物理高度。
source_label: 圆谷官方本人图鉴（简体中文整理）

fact_sources.original_description: An evolved form of Chaos-Header’s physical body, born when it copied not only Ultraman Cosmos’ physical form, but also his fighting abilities and tactics. This form can release 50 times more Chaos Energy than a single unit of Chaos-Header. Chaos-Header managed to get hold of Musashi, copy Cosmos’ powers, and materialize them. It began to battle with Cosmos and defeated him with a series of Impeding Wave and Chaos Prominence attacks. It then returned to light virus form and imprisoned Musashi. TEAM EYES were eventually able to free him, and they battled again. This time Chaos-Ultraman had Chaos-Neldrant II on its side, but when it was hit with the Eclipse Blade its cells began to panic, and vanished after being hit by a Cosmium Beam. From that point onward it was thought to be annihilated, but its abilities evolved and it reappeared in the D-9 Area. As Cosmos Eclipse Mode entered the scene, it powered up to become Chaos-Ultraman Calamity.
